text:
Maya Chen: FYI - we're getting hit from a spike in failed onboarding webhooks in EU this morning, affecting ~120 trial tenants. Root cause narrow so far but customers are seeing partial index failures and slowed activation flows. Pulling a comm together, need quick alignment on messages/credits/office hours. :warning:

Liam O'Connor: Thanks Maya. We're seeing a backlog in the ingest queue due to a GC/connection surge on the indexing service. Engineers are throttling retries and rolling a patch now. ETA for fix ~45-60m. I'll post the deploy link when it's up.

Rahul Patel: Rolling window looks like 03:10-03:45 UTC started. We're also hitting transient 502s from a downstream partner. Mitigation: retry-backoff + circuit-breaker applied, and we've increased consumer group parallelism to clear backlog. No correlated data loss detected.

Sofia Alvarez: Draft for customer update below — please review and flag edits. We'll send to affected tenants first and then post a status page update.

Sofia Alvarez: "
Hi there — we're experiencing intermittent onboarding delays for some trial accounts in EU. Our engineers have identified a service backlog affecting index writes which may cause slower activation and search results while we clear the queue.

What we're doing: rolling a patch and applying a retry/circuit-breaker to reduce retries and clear outstanding items. We expect normal onboarding to resume within 1-2 hours.

If you're impacted: we will reach out directly with next steps and offer a one-month credits package for affected trials. We've opened dedicated office hours at X to help any high-touch accounts.

We apologize for the interruption and will follow up with an RCA once the incident is closed.

— Redwood Inference Support
"

Maya Chen: Nice. Two asks: 1) can we make the credit standardized (e.g., $250 credit for trials under 3 months, custom offers for enterprise)? 2) need a short FAQ and an opt-in for a 1:1 enablement slot.

Sofia Alvarez: Agree on standardization. I'll create a simple matrix and include help link. Draft FAQ bullets: "Why did this happen?", "How will you know it's resolved?", "How to request a 1:1?" Short answers only.

Liam O'Connor: Deploy is live: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/ingest-patch-4521 — patch reduces retry storm and improves backpressure. Consumer group drain started at 1751240000. Monitoring clear.

DeployBot: Deployment succeeded — roll/ingest-patch-4521 — 6 instances updated — 1751240065

Rahul Patel: Backlog drain progress: 30% cleared in first 12m, 70% cleared at 40m. No new 502 spikes in the last 10m. Will keep throttle in place for another 30m to be safe.

Sofia Alvarez: Sending to affected list now (first pass), subject: "Quick update — onboarding delays for some EU trials". Copy below for threads/CS emails: "
Hi <Customer name>,

Thanks for your patience — we noticed an issue impacting onboarding for some customers in EU and have applied a fix and mitigations. Your trial may be slower to finish indexing; if you need us to prioritize your account we can run a manual backfill and offer a $250 credit to your account.

Reply to this email or click here to book a slot: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

Apologies again — we'll follow up with a full RCA.

Best,
Sofia on behalf of Redwood CS
"

Maya Chen: Good. I'll coordinate the exec-brief for any renewal-risk accounts >$10k ARR. Also flagging these customers in the renewal queue so AE can reach out.

Sofia Alvarez: I'm adding a short survey link to capture feedback post-recovery so we can quantify impact for renewal conversations.

Rahul Patel: RCA notes for later: root cause = retry amplification due to downstream 502s + GC pause on the indexing workers that prevented queue consumers from keeping up. Fixes: improved retry/backoff logic, consumer parallelism, and GC tuning. We'll put remediation steps in the postmortem doc.

Maya Chen: Call-out for CS ops: list of high-touch customers affected: @Sofia please attach the CSV. We should prepare tailored emails + offer WA for renewals teams.

Sofia Alvarez: Attached CSV sent in DMs. Also scheduling two office hours slots (EU friendly): 09:30 and 14:00 CET. I'll include both in the customer note.

Maya Chen: Timeline/next steps for this thread: 1) final customer email send (Sofia) — in 10m 2) update status page (Ops) — once last_message_ts shows drain complete 3) post-incident RCA + comms package for renewals (Maya + Rahul + Liam) — draft within 24h 4) feedback capture + credits issued (Sofia) — within 48h.

CS Bot: Noted — incident INC-4521 has been updated to status: mitigated. Office hours links attached: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

Liam O'Connor: Confirming no data corruption. Will add the GC tuning patch to next week's release train.

Sofia Alvarez: Sent first wave of emails to affected trials, including booking link and credit offer. I'll post engagement metrics in this thread once responses come in. :email:

Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll work with AEs to prioritize renewal-risk touches and pull together the RCA communications for tomorrow's AM. If anything changes, ping here. :pray:
